name: Debian 13
author: hello@soneyko.ai
description: Persistent Debian Linux environment with a terminal and apt. Installed packages and files survive restarts and container recreation. Runs as an unprivileged PRoot guest in the server volume; this is a Linux userspace, not a virtual machine with its own kernel or systemd.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.instance
echo 'Linux environment will be initialized on first start.'
